name: Haran
overview: The Scripture introduces Haran as a significant figure in the genealogy of Abraham, being his brother and the father of Lot, as recorded in Genesis 11:26-27. Haran died in his homeland before his father Terah, who later led his family, including Abram and Lot, from Ur of the Chaldees to the land of Canaan, stopping and dwelling in the city named Haran (Genesis 11:28, 31). This narrative highlights God's providential guidance in the journey of Abraham’s family and sets the stage for the unfolding of God's covenant promises through Abram.
